name: Olive & Sun-Dried Tomato Swirl
description: A spiralled round layered with green and kalamata olives, sun-dried tomato, herbs and grated cheese. Crisp at the edges, soft through the middle.

name: Jalapeño, Olive & Red Onion
description: Our signature round — fresh jalapeño, mixed olives, red onion and herbs across a golden, dimpled crust.

name: Roasted Garlic & Sea Salt
description: Simple and perfect. Olive oil, roasted garlic and flaky salt on a pillowy sourdough crumb.

name: Cheesy Jalapeño
description: Melted and bubbling, with jalapeño baked right into the top.

name: The Country Loaf
description: Naturally leavened with the same starter that lifts the focaccia — mixed the day before, left to rise slow, and baked dark.

name: Cinnamon Swirl with Vanilla Drizzle
description: A whole pan of cinnamon-laced focaccia pulled apart in golden ridges and finished with a vanilla glaze.

name: Honey Focaccia Bites
description: Pull-apart bites, boxed and drizzled with Chetco Gold raw honey.

name: Jalapeño & Roasted Garlic Muffins
description: Hand-sized, crisp-edged, crowned with jalapeño and toasted garlic.

name: Peppered Pickle Muffins
description: Brookings Pickled Goodies’ spicy bread-and-butter pickles, infused right into the dough.

name: Sea Salt Rolls
description: Soft pull-apart rounds, olive-oil brushed and salt flaked.

name: Heart Loaf
description: A little hand-shaped heart. They go fast.

name: Flower Garden
description: Hand-painted in vegetables and herbs — a whole garden across the top of the dough.
